consequence.statement: If the upgrade steps (upgrade CNI, restart ambient workloads, upgrade Ztunnel) are not followed, DNS resolution failures occur.
consequence.remediation: Restart the affected workloads to resolve DNS failures; follow order: upgrade Istio CNI, restart ambient-enrolled workloads, upgrade Ztunnel.

assertion.statement: Upgrading to Istio 1.24.0 in ambient mode with cni.ambient.dnsCapture=true requires upgrading Istio CNI, restarting ambient-enrolled workloads, then upgrading Ztunnel, otherwise DNS resolution fails.
